mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.images, a.author_id AS authorId, u.nick_name AS authorName, a.published_at AS publishedAt FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.published_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.images, a.author_id AS authorId, u.nick_name AS authorName, a.published_at AS publishedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT al.id) AS likeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.id) AS commentCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_likes al ON a.id = al.article_id LEFT JOIN article_comments ac ON a.id = ac.article_id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.published_at >= (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) * 1000)::BIGINT - 2592000000 GROUP BY a.id, u.nick_name, a.title, a.content, a.images, a.author_id, a.published_at ORDER BY likeCount DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.images, a.author_id AS authorId, u.nick_name AS authorName, a.published_at AS publishedAt, a.category_id AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT al.id) AS likeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.id) AS commentCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_likes al ON a.id = al.article_id LEFT JOIN article_comments ac ON a.id = ac.article_id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.category_id=#{type} GROUP BY a.id, u.nick_name, a.title, a.content, a.images, a.author_id, a.published_at ORDER BY likeCount DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.images, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, a.author_id AS authorId, u.nick_name AS authorName, a.published_at AS publishedAt, a.category_id AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT al.id) AS likeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT ac.id) AS commentCount FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_likes al ON a.id = al.article_id LEFT JOIN article_comments ac ON a.id = ac.article_id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.id=#{id} GROUP BY a.id, u.nick_name, a.title, a.content, a.images, a.author_id, a.published_at,u.avatar_url

SELECT ac.id, ac.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, ac.content AS content, ac.parent_id AS parentId, ac.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserID, ru.nick_name AS replyToUserName, ac.created_at AS createdAt FROM article_comments ac LEFT JOIN users u ON ac.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users ru ON ac.reply_to_user_id=ru.id WHERE ac.article_id = #{id} order by ac.created_at desc
